_comment: Canonical experiment config schema. All fields required unless marked [optional].
round: [explicit human round, e.g. r1; not inferred from lap or date suffix]

deployment._comment: Required before new registration. See train/execution.md: explicit target/basis, bounded probe or same-contract closed-loop proof before formal deployment training. Unknown blocks; no default simulation exemption.

checkpoint._comment: Register exact final saved iteration from the framework before launch. For a continuation, parent must include the actual SHA256 and iteration; include optimizerStep/normalizerCount when the framework restores them. execution.terminal/delivery are written here by oma run, not in extra state files.

data.test_path: [path — NOT loaded during train or tune]

execution._comment: Launch admission: pipeline is stable and reusable by single-level ref; plan is the actual secret-free platform request/command. resource binds its quote to preflight resourcePlanSha256. account stores public identity/profile/keyEnv/baseUrl only. Deployment stage/probe use deployment fields; simulation-only execution declares stage/probe here. Terminal/delivery are maintained by oma run.
